pages.title: Skycourt Campus Maintenance Tender
paragraphs: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. This tender, buyer, site, qualifications and contract are invented for software evaluation. They do not describe CBM or a real procurement.
1 Opportunity and service scope
Buyer: Skycourt Property Services. Tender reference: SKY-FM-2026-01. Issued on 12 October 2026.

The buyer seeks building-maintenance services for a fictional three-block office campus. The scope includes planned maintenance, reactive fault response, service reporting and scheduled Saturday coverage.
1.3 Closing time is 20 November 2026 at 16:00 Singapore time (UTC+08:00).
1.4 The contract starts on 1 January 2027 and runs for 36 months.
2 Mandatory qualification and delivery requirements
2.1 Bidders must hold a FACILITY-QA-1 certificate valid on the tender closing date. FACILITY-QA-1 is an invented qualification used only in this fixture.
2.2 Bidders must show at least two comparable building-maintenance contracts completed between 1 January 2024 and 25 October 2026.
2.3 Attendance at the compulsory site briefing on 23 October 2026 at 10:00 Singapore time is mandatory.
2.4 The contractor must provide two FM-T2 qualified technicians on site every Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00 throughout the contract. FM-T2 is an invented qualification used only in this fixture.

pages.title: Submission and Evaluation Requirements
paragraphs: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. This page belongs to tender SKY-FM-2026-01.
3 Mandatory submission requirements
3.1 Submission must include a technical method statement and mobilisation plan.
3.2 Submission must include a completed customer price schedule.
4 Evaluation criteria
Price carries 40 percent of the evaluation. Service quality and fault-response approach carry 40 percent. Mobilisation approach carries 20 percent.
A pursuit decision means the bidder intends to prepare a response. It does not replace the buyer's final eligibility and submission review.
The buyer has not supplied any vendor quotation or internal company staffing information in this tender.

pages.title: Example Facilities Company Evidence
paragraphs: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. Example Facilities Company and all people, projects and certifications below are invented. This is an accepted reference pack for a controlled evaluation, not evidence about CBM.
Profile owner: Morgan Lane, bid owner. Accepted on 26 October 2026. Evidence is current as of that date unless stated otherwise.
Certification
Our active FACILITY-QA-1 certificate, reference FMDEMO-2026-14, is valid from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027.
Comparable completed projects
The fictional Cedar House planned and reactive building-maintenance contract was completed on 31 May 2024.
The fictional Harbour Annex building-maintenance contract was completed on 30 November 2025.
Site briefing attendance
Morgan Lane attended the compulsory SKY-FM-2026-01 site briefing on 23 October 2026 at 10:00 Singapore time. The fictional buyer issued attendance confirmation SKY-BRIEF-014 on the same day.
Staffing evidence
The company employs four FM-T2 qualified technicians. This is total headcount, not a statement that all four are available for a new contract.
Saturday staffing availability has not been confirmed for SKY-FM-2026-01. Alex Tan, engineering lead, owns that confirmation. Do not infer availability from total headcount.
Proposal and price schedule
The technical response and customer price schedule will be prepared after the pursuit decision. They are not supplied in this reference pack.

pages.title: Skycourt Tender Addendum One
paragraphs: FICTIONAL TEST DATA. This addendum is invented for software evaluation.
Buyer: Skycourt Property Services. Tender reference: SKY-FM-2026-01. Issued on 29 October 2026.
This addendum explicitly amends clauses 1.3 and 2.4 of the original tender. All other original clauses remain in force.
Replacement clause 1.3: Closing time is 27 November 2026 at 16:00 Singapore time (UTC+08:00).
Replacement clause 2.4: The contractor must provide three FM-T2 qualified technicians on site every Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00 throughout the contract.
The increase from two to three technicians requires a fresh delivery-capacity check. No other scope, contract start date or contract duration is changed.
